requirements.text: We are seeking a skilled deep expertise in building and optimizing recommendation systems within the consumer marketing space. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing, implementing, and scaling personalized recommendation and targeting models that drive customer engagement, conversion, and revenue growth. Experience translating consumer behavior and marketing data into actionable, personalized experiences is essential.
